documented_probe: Parametric mechanical-part geometry engine (bolt-circle spacer/flange): the agent authors an importable pure-Python cadmodel module (bolt-hole centers, edge clearances, annular area, volume, mass, validate_spec, build_report) and a rounded JSON report for a visible spec. The verifier imports /app/cadmodel.py and re-runs every function on hidden specs (bolt counts 1/2/12/24, tiny margins, planted multi-code violations, boundary-touch cases, malformed values, float-vs-int bolt counts, missing keys) under three limits variants, plus an independent recompute of /app/spacer_report.json.
notes: Medium: quantitative_correctness 2 because every reported number must match an independent recompute to 4 decimals under exact documented conventions (angles, overlap handling, rounding, sort order); hidden_case_generalization 2 because hidden specs span edge shapes and limits variants so hardcoding the visible report fails; adversarial_inputs 2 from malformed-field specs (strings, bools, negative/zero values, float bolt count, missing keys); dependent_stages 2 because the module and the JSON report must agree with each other and with the verifier. No tool breadth or resource pressure: pure stdlib math, single-digit-second runtime.
